scope: offline TRAIN/VAL supplemental review; no adoption or historical gate revision
size_correct: canonical long and short relative errors both <= 0.10
missing_output: unavailable observation; no quality risk and excluded from FA/FR/ED/CR
adjacency: same sequence and consecutive observed frame indices; gaps reset; not seconds

prospective_contract.applies_to: future independently versioned candidates only, before fit; no retrospective promotion
prospective_contract.correct_retention: >=95% per domain/video on VAL using one global cutoff; no domain/video routing online
prospective_contract.ranking: overall same-count FA strictly below both frozen full_simple and score; per-domain/video FA nonincrease; tie FA lower bound protects against optimistic control ordering
prospective_contract.matched_correct_retention: also report FA and coverage at matched CR; no pooled-only success claim
prospective_contract.correct_observation_continuity: longest consecutive FR run must not increase versus either same-count control in each group; additionally report FR counts and CR/all-frame coverage
prospective_contract.unsafe_observation_continuity: report FA run lengths and composition; stable acceptance of errors is not a benefit
prospective_contract.availability_cost: report ED runs, missing runs, total unavailable runs and flag switches separately; total unavailable nonincrease is not a standalone rejection gate
prospective_contract.limits: no guarantee on unseen videos; offline GT determines evaluation only; no mechanical safety guarantee
prospective_contract.TEST: freeze candidate/parameters/cutoff before report; no TEST selection; no TEST read in this supplement
prospective_contract.preservation: original boxes/score/output identity, center/angle flags and original policy unchanged
